split_rule.description: Per-sequence deterministic split by MD5 of the sequence header
split_rule.rationale: Homology-independent, reproducible, no data movement; mirrors NucleicBERT's 80/20 with an explicit held-out test tier.

note: Headers are the FASTA description lines; implement by streaming with Bio.SeqIO or `zcat | awk '/^>/{...}'`.
